svg.title: ComparaFarma logo exploration board — 10 abstract orientation concepts
svg.desc: A 2-row by 5-column grid of ten minimalist black linework icons on white, each exploring the concept of orientation: direction arrow, decision point, north marker, intelligent path, crossroads, navigation marker, compass, best route, converging information, and an abstract orientation glyph. Labeled 01 through 10.
